notes: Sheet 4H (Height and Bulk Districts, Lincoln Park / outer Richmond), June 1990 edition. Single heavy frame rule (~10 px) on the left, top and right; The bottom edge sits just above the thick top bar of the ruled-off legend and title strip (README rule 3: the strip is outside, with the district key, the planning-code note, the north arrow, the scale bar and the sheet number printed in it, so there is no remove polygon). Each side's inner edge was measured line by line from the scan (the longest dark run across the rule, its inner end), smoothed with a robust local-linear fit (+-300 px, residuals over 2.5 px dropped, so map ink running into a rule and 1 px nubs do not pull it), and the outline set 2 px inside the fit's 95th-percentile inner edge (README rule 1: the 1-bit rules are stair-stepped with 1 px nubs), points every ~200 px; corners where the fitted sides meet, then moved 2 px further in on both axes to clear the small rounded fillets inside the frame's corners. Measured paper between outline and rule: median 2-3 px, at most 5 px anywhere (README rule 8). The legend bar's top edge rises ~38 px (y decreasing) from left to right while the top rule is level within ~3 px; each side follows its own rule. The heavy vertical line at x ~2899 (y ~1300 to the street line at y ~3805) is a printed map line with blocks and shoreline on both sides of it, not a frame rule: inside. 'SEE SHEET 3H' (right margin) and 'SEE SHEET 5H' (below Golden Gate Park) are cross-references with no ruled box: inside (rule 4). No compass rose, legend block or SECTION badge inside the frame, so no remove polygon. PACIFIC OCEAN, LINCOLN PARK, GOLDEN GATE PARK, OS / 40-X codes are map. No map ink touches the frame. Ink under the outline: none.
